definitions.gloss: gym clothes; PE uniform; sportswear (for school PE)
definitions.explanation: The clothing students change into for physical education ({体育|たいいく}) class at Japanese schools, typically a T-shirt and shorts or a tracksuit.

examples.japanese: {体育着|たいいくぎ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着替|きが}える→着替える：04603_kigaeru⟧。
examples.english: I change into my gym clothes.

examples.japanese: {体育着|たいいくぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{忘|わす}れて→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧きた。
examples.english: I left my gym clothes at home.

examples.japanese: ⟦{体育|たいいく}→体育：03384_taiiku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{体育着|たいいくぎ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着替|きが}えて→着替える：04603_kigaeru⟧⟦{校庭|こうてい}→校庭：04147_koutei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: Before PE class, we all changed into our gym clothes and gathered on the school grounds.

notes:
{体育着|たいいくぎ} is the gym uniform Japanese students wear for ⟦{体育|たいいく}→体育：03384_taiiku⟧ (physical education). The {着|ぎ} suffix (a voiced form of {着|き}) means 'clothing for ~.'

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {体育着|たいいくぎ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着替|きが}える→着替える：04603_kigaeru⟧: to change into gym clothes
- {体育着|たいいくぎ}{袋|ぶくろ}: gym-clothes bag

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{体操着|たいそうぎ}→体操着：24194_taisougi⟧: gym clothes — a near-synonym, used interchangeably in many schools
- ⟦{運動着|うんどうぎ}→運動着：25709_undougi⟧: sportswear — more general athletic clothing
